left.raw_text: Psychotic depression by DSM-IV, i.e., presence of delusions with a SCID-R score higher than 2;
High suicide risk, i.e. intent or plan to attempt suicide in near future;
Presence of any Axis I psychiatric disorder (other than unipolar major depression) or substance abuse;
History of psychiatric disorders other than unipolar major depression or generalized anxiety disorder (bipolar disorder, hypomania, and dysthymia are exclusion criteria);
Dementia: Diagnosis of dementia by DSM-IV;

Acute or severe medical illness, i.e., delirium, metastatic cancer, decompensated cardiac, liver or kidney failure, major surgery, stroke or myocardial infarction during the three months prior to entry;
use of drugs known to cause depression, e.g., reserpine, alpha-methyl-dopa, steroids, sympathomimetics withdrawal;
